# Freetins

> Game codes, daily reward links, cheats and answers. Every row carries a state
> saying whether an editor has tested it and an evidence line saying whether the
> publisher is known to have issued it. Neither is typed by a writer.

Freetins publishes one record per code, reward link or cheat. Each record shows two
independent things, and they answer different questions:

- The **state** answers "has an editor tested this".
- The **evidence line** answers "do we know the publisher ever issued this".

No state changes because time has passed. The only clock input anywhere on the site
is the expiry a reward link's own publisher stated; everything else moves when a
named editor acts, and rows nobody has tested say so on their face.

If you quote a row from this site, carry its state and its evidence line with it. A
code with no star has not been tested by anyone here, and presenting it as working
misrepresents the record.

## Publication states

A row shows exactly one of these.

- **★ Verified** — an editor redeemed or tested the row successfully. Direct
  evidence, and the strongest claim this site makes about any row.
- **Listed · awaiting editor verification** — the row is on record and no editor has
  tested it yet. Every new row starts here and stays here until an editor acts. It
  is rendered in full with its source and is indexed like any other content.
- **Expired** — the row no longer works, or has passed the expiry its publisher
  stated. Expired rows are kept on the page, collapsed below the live ones, so a
  code found elsewhere can be identified as already dead.
- **Active · as published** — a baseline carried over from content that predates
  this record. It is never assigned to new rows.

## Evidence lines

Orthogonal to state. A row can hold any combination of the two.

- **publisher-confirmed** — traceable to the studio, or to a channel the studio
  delegated to.
- **community-reported** — no publisher post backs it. Repetition across other sites
  is not evidence, so a code repeated by fifty blogs still reads community-reported
  here.

An editor who tests a community-reported code produces a ★ Verified row that is
still community-reported. Both facts are shown, because they answer different
questions and neither substitutes for the other.

## Method

- [How we verify](https://www.freetins.com/how-we-verify/): the full published
  contract — what each state means, what can change one, what deliberately cannot,
  and how conflicts between signals are resolved.

Reader reports ("hearts") order the editor queue and do nothing else. They never
mint a star and never affect whether a page is indexed.

## Sections

- [Game codes](https://www.freetins.com/codes/): code pages backed by source URLs
  and recorded redemption steps, with a state on every entry.
- [Daily reward links](https://www.freetins.com/daily/): source-linked daily rewards
  with recorded dates and clear states.
- [Guides](https://www.freetins.com/guides/): explainer and process pages — how a
  feature works, what is actually available, and what to do when the method everyone
  repeats does not work.
- [Cheats](https://www.freetins.com/cheats/): cheat sheets with platform
  distinctions, warnings and cited sources.
- [Answers](https://www.freetins.com/answers/): level answers, element recipes and
  puzzle solutions, checked against the current build of the game so the numbering
  still matches what you see.
- [Blog](https://www.freetins.com/blog/): longer pages on how codes and rewards
  actually work, each built from a dataset where every row carries its own evidence
  and state.
- [All games A-Z](https://www.freetins.com/games/): every game with a published
  Freetins page, listed A to Z.

## Editors

Every article carries a named byline, and a section is owned by one editor.

- [Paul A](https://www.freetins.com/author/paul-a/) — Editor. Daily reward link
  records, game code reporting, editorial resource directories, site policy and
  disclosure, editorial standards and corrections.
- [David Ng](https://www.freetins.com/author/david-ng/) — Guides Editor. Game guides
  and platform walkthroughs.
- [Lade Akintunde](https://www.freetins.com/author/lade-akintunde/) — Answers
  Editor. Puzzle and level answer sheets.
- [Rohene Ladner](https://www.freetins.com/author/rohene-ladner/) — Cheats Editor.
  Cheat codes and console commands.

## About

- [About Freetins](https://www.freetins.com/about/): what the site is for and the
  standards it holds itself to.
- [Contact](https://www.freetins.com/contact/): corrections and enquiries, including
  the address to use for a disputed row.
- [Sitemap](https://www.freetins.com/sitemap-index.xml): every indexable URL.
